notes: Large-source unit עַד־לְמַעְלָה → exceedingly retained: the two prepositions, adverb and directive he are one fixed expression rendered by a single word of which no morpheme owns a part (rules 30, 32), headed on the lexeme-bearing מַעַל. 'waxed' assigned to the written הָיָה with the progressive הֹלֵךְ unrepresented; the reverse allocation is defensible and named in the unit note.
